data.description: JSON substitution data, including nested objects and arrays, is passed unchanged to SES. SES stored templates do not automatically escape HTML: callers must escape untrusted values for their HTML context. Maximum serialized JSON length: 262,144 characters.

screen.description: Ask the installation’s content classifier (Jev) whether this message is unsolicited advertising smuggled into a transactional template, e.g. an ad placed in a user-supplied name. Screened messages that look like spam are rejected before delivery with error code CONTENT_REJECTED_SPAM and a reject event; nothing reaches the provider. Transactional messages only; ignored for marketing and when SES is simulated. Skipped (and logged) when the installation has no classifier configured.

CampaignDraft.description: Drafts may omit sender, subject, content and audience until review or send. Durable campaign preparation is bounded and runs in background jobs.
